faqs.q: What does the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range do on a quick coupling?
faqs.a: The Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range is a set of caps that cover or close the open end of a quick coupling half, keeping dirt, grit and moisture out of the coupling while it is disconnected. It is listed with 4 part numbers in 1/4" to 1", in the Indus Dust Caps & Plugs range.

faqs.q: How do I read part number AG8DC in the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range?
faqs.a: AG8DC is one part number of the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps, and the size table gives the description and size of each one. In the table: AG8DC is Agricultural Dust Cap, 1 Inch Body Size, Elastomer; AG6DC is Agricultural Dust Cap, 3/4 Inch Body Size, Elastomer; AG3DC is Agricultural Dust Cap, 3/8 Inch Body Size, Elastomer. Quote the full part number when you order, and the part number of the mating coupling half if you have it.

faqs.q: Which sizes are in the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range?
faqs.a: The Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range is listed in 4 part numbers, covering 1/4" to 1". For example AG8DC is Agricultural Dust Cap, 1 Inch Body Size, Elastomer and AG3DC is Agricultural Dust Cap, 3/8 Inch Body Size, Elastomer. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists every one.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size from the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range?
faqs.a: Choose from the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range by the size of the coupling half it must cover, then by its series or interchange profile, because a cap or plug only seals properly on the coupling it was made for. Read the size from the table; for example AG6DC is Agricultural Dust Cap, 3/4 Inch Body Size, Elastomer. Our [guide to photographing a fitting for identification](/blog/photographing-a-hydraulic-fitting) shows what to send if you only have the old part.

faqs.q: What pressure is the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range rated for?
faqs.a: A dust cap is a cover, not a pressure-retaining part, and the listing for the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range publishes no pressure rating for it. The coupling it sits on sets the working pressure of the line. Tell us if the cover will sit on a line that is pressurised or exposed to heat, and we will check the choice.

faqs.q: What is the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range made from?
faqs.a: The Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range is listed in elastomer for quick Disconnect couplings. Pick the material for the environment: rubber and vinyl covers are flexible and light, metal covers are harder wearing.

faqs.q: Which standard does the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range follow?
faqs.a: The listing for the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range does not name a standard for the covers themselves. What matters is that the cover matches the coupling profile and size, so quote the part number of the coupling half. No test certificate is attached to the listing; tell us the documents your project needs when you ask for a quotation.

faqs.q: What coupling does the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range fit?
faqs.a: The Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range fits the coupling half named in the table for each part number, and only that coupling profile and size. Quick couplings only seal and flow at their rating when both halves come from the same interchange profile, so quote the part number of the mating half too, or tell us what it must connect to, and we will confirm the match before supply.

faqs.q: How do I use the Dixon AG Series Dust Caps range on a coupling?
faqs.a: Push or screw the cap onto the clean end of the coupling half as soon as it is disconnected, and keep it on until the line is reconnected. Wipe the coupling face before you remove the cover, so dirt on the cover does not enter the line. See our [guide to storing fittings on site](/blog/storing-fittings-and-seals-on-site).
